mapper.select: SELECT * FROM openviking_settings WHERE id = 'global' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openviking_settings (id, base_url, trusted_mode_enabled, account_id, plugin_package, root_api_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{baseUrl}, #{trustedModeEnabled}, #{accountId}, #{pluginPackage}, #{rootApiKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_url = VALUES(base_url), trusted_mode_enabled = VALUES(trusted_mode_enabled), account_id = VALUES(account_id), plugin_package = VALUES(plugin_package), root_api_key = VALUES(root_api_key), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
